purpose: Repair exactly V6A5-AUD-B001 through V6A5-AUD-B011 with a mechanically closed effective governance model before any Candidate V6, compiler, code, preflight, data, R4, outcome or scientific access.

v4_exact_extract_source.authority: Exact extraction only for the inherited four Stage-A directory-intent templates, twenty governance-header owner identities, thirteen Root flush path keys and schema values explicitly inherited by V5. This source is not an activation gate.

v4_exact_extract_audit.authority: Historical provenance only; never reinterpreted as PASS and never required as a Stage-A PASS gate.

exact_inherited_extracts.extraction_rule: Each value above is byte-semantically derived only from static:v4 at its exact bound hash. V6 copies the displayed value and binds the source pointer, whole-source bytes/SHA-256 and canonical extracted-value bytes/SHA-256. A source mismatch, different order or additional item is FAIL_BLOCKING.

crash_and_incident_state_repair.resolution_rule: The checkpoint and normalized-outcome arrays are exact deep copies of static:v5 at /crash_and_incident_state_repair. The trigger and state arrays are the sole V6 extensions and are byte-equal to their displayed V6 sources. These exact top-level names close every retained V5 enum_source.

process_start_repair.resolution_rule: The five rows and order are byte-equal to the bound V5 source. PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 resolves only here; no derived or caller-selected row exists.

root_staging_content_read_repair.resolution_rule: The six operations and order are byte-equal to static:v5. STAGING_FILE_READ_OBSERVATION_V5 resolves its constraint only to this array.

scope_and_non_evidence.source_verdict_rule: The V5 and V4 FAIL receipts remain immutable FAIL_BLOCKING historical records. V6 supersedes their enumerated defects prospectively; it never changes either verdict, never selects against later output and never retroactively authorizes an action.
preserved_pass_surfaces: Root selected-branch staging content reads remain exactly four SUCCESS files or three FAILURE files after P1 and never both.
Every selected staging file retains the exact six-operation read, hash and deep-validation sequence and every incident retains a truthful contiguous prefix.
Composite source pointers, prior-value checks, literal specialization inclusion and unique physical-path byte/hash invariants remain noncompensatory.
GENERIC_WRITE 0x40000000, share 0x00000007, exact file or directory flags, FlushFileBuffers then CloseHandle, and zero mutation remain exact.
All V4/V5 path, writer, independence, no-delete, no-overwrite, no-retry, no-science and fail-closed rules remain exact except the eleven displayed repairs.
scope_and_non_evidence.no_evidence_rule: This amendment, its audit, activation, role freeze, schemas, plans, receipts and every data-free bootstrap artifact have zero scientific authority and cannot support a claim, gate, grade, advancement, outcome or human transfer.

path_registry_extension.path_rule: All inherited V5/V4 path IDs retain their bound relative paths. The four static V6 paths and four exact P5 paths are the only additions. Each P5 file is a direct child of its already-registered transaction parent, so no new directory creation is authorized. Every future output is absent before CREATE_NEW and cannot be appended, overwritten, replaced, renamed, deleted or reused.

route.prestage_rule: Stage A is reachable only after an independent V6 PASS receipt binds final static:v6, a distinct Root writes static:v6_activation, and Root writes static:v6_role_assignment_freeze. Neither historical FAIL receipt is a PASS gate. All later gates remain ordered and noncompensatory.
route.no_retroactive_selection: Every actor, delegation chain, schema, access set, flush plan, authorization, directory intent, threshold, expected value and incident route freezes before the event it governs.

canonical_model.canonicalization: UTF-8 json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False). Registered arrays retain declared order. No NaN, Infinity, duplicate key, omitted required field or additional field.
canonical_model.schema_rule: Every direct V6 schema has the exact field_order and fields displayed, requires every field key, rejects additional fields and applies type, const, enum, ref, count, order and conditional rules conjunctively. For the five exact patch keys in effective_base_plus_patch_schema_registry, the fully materialized base-plus-patch output—not the same-named typed descriptor-source body—is the sole schema value and its computed field_order, fields, source conditionals, additional_fields and hash domain are authoritative. Artifact records have one final HASH_ENVELOPE_V4 excluded only from their own hash domain. Components are never independently serialized.
canonical_model.enum_source_rule: A dot-separated enum_source resolves literally within static:v6. The suffix ' plus NULL' appends JSON null exactly once. exact_values_source resolves the complete displayed array with byte-equal order. No caller may extend or reorder either source.
canonical_model.unknown_rule: Any unresolved reference, path token, enum source, pointer, count, condition, operation, phase, state or hash domain is FAIL_BLOCKING.

role_identity_and_delegation_model.pair_index_formula: For 0<=i<j<18, pair_index=i*(35-i)/2+(j-i-1); rows are ordered by i then j and cover integers 0 through 152 once.
role_identity_and_delegation_model.pair_join_rule: Each ROLE_CONFLICT_JOIN_ROW_V6 left and right identity tuple is byte-equal to the assignments at left_role_index and right_role_index. Its six dimension rows are ordered exactly as identity_dimensions_in_exact_order. The delegation dimension additionally embeds one DELEGATION_DISJOINTNESS_PROOF_V6 computed from those same two embedded chains.
role_identity_and_delegation_model.delegation_proof_rule: For every operational pair, auditor-to-role pair and auditor-to-Root pair, canonical sets are extracted from both bound DELEGATION_CHAIN_V6 objects. Every displayed intersection array equals the raw-UTF-8-sorted mathematical intersection and is exact empty. Whole-chain SHA inequality is required but is integrity evidence only, never the disjointness proof.
role_identity_and_delegation_model.audit_timing_rule: The V6 audit receipt binds only the auditor tuple and chain. ROOT_ACTIVATION_V6 later binds the Root tuple and exact auditor-to-Root comparison. ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_FREEZE_V6 later binds all 18 assignments, 153 role pairs and 18 auditor comparisons; no future identity is asserted at audit time.

process_and_checkpoint_model.process_outcome_authority: CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V6.process_start_outcome_or_null is the sole authoritative process-start object in every publication, P5 and incident record. INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V6 has no second process outcome field. Before C5 it is null with phase BEFORE_C5_NOT_CALLED; at C5 and later it is nonnull and byte-equal to the exact C5 PROCESS_START_OUTCOME_V5 observation with phase C5_OR_LATER_AUTHORITATIVE.
process_and_checkpoint_model.adjacency_join_rule: A failure ledger joins exactly one of the fourteen failure rows by byte-equality of branch, last_completed and first_failed. A no-failure ledger joins exactly one successful-prefix row by branch and last_completed. No checkpoint after first_failed may be entered, observed or claimed.
process_and_checkpoint_model.trigger_lookup_rule: The fourteen values of trigger_lookup_by_failure_class are a permutation of incident_trigger_ids_in_exact_order. C2 EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION with exact unchanged READY is the sole failure-class exception and has no incident trigger. P4 explicit unchanged and P4 uncertainty share the one preauthorized P4 trigger but remain disjoint states through P4_PUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6.
process_and_checkpoint_model.trigger_rule: INCIDENT_AUTHORIZATION_V6 freezes all fourteen tokens before claim. Every first failure maps to exactly one token; no receipt may name an unlisted token and no authorization may omit, add or reorder one.
process_and_checkpoint_model.P4_explicit_failure_predicate: The P4 API reports explicit failure, final publication_attestation is proven ABSENT, and either staging is proven ABSENT_UNCHANGED because construction never created it or staging is proven PRESENT_COMPLETE_UNCHANGED_FROM_PRE_RENAME after an explicit no-replace rename failure. All relevant identities are proven and no partial, mutating, no-return, uncertain or interrupted observation exists. Authorization is spent and no retry exists.
process_and_checkpoint_model.P4_uncertainty_predicate: At least one required final or staging absence, presence, identity, hash, close or rename postcondition is partial, changed, missing, conflicting, no-return or interrupted. It is disjoint from the explicit unchanged-failure predicate.

state_predicates_exact.READY_DURABLE_UNCLAIMED: READY present exact and CLAIMED absent before C2; no claim API entered.
state_predicates_exact.CLAIM_EXPLICIT_FAILURE_UNCHANGED_READY_U: C2 returned explicit failure; READY exact identity/hash unchanged; CLAIMED absent; authorization unspent; no worker.
state_predicates_exact.CLAIM_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT: C2 entered but explicit unchanged-READY proof is absent, partial, conflicting or no-return; authorization spent; no retry.
state_predicates_exact.CLAIMED_DURABLE_HANDOFF_ABSENT_SPENT: C3 proves READY absent and CLAIMED present exact; handoff not yet present; authorization spent.
state_predicates_exact.CLAIMED_HANDOFF_DURABLE_PRESTART_SPENT: C4 proves exact final handoff; CreateProcessW not yet entered; authorization spent.
state_predicates_exact.PROCESS_START_NOT_STARTED_PROVEN_SPENT: C5 authoritative process outcome is NOT_STARTED_PROVEN after claim; authorization spent; no retry.
state_predicates_exact.PROCESS_START_UNKNOWN_SPENT: C5 authoritative process outcome is UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT; authorization spent; no retry.
state_predicates_exact.WORKER_STARTED_PROVEN_SPENT: C5 authoritative process outcome is STARTED_PROVEN and no controller interruption has been selected.
state_predicates_exact.STAGED_SUCCESS_SELECTED_SPENT: P1 proves exactly complete SUCCESS staging and failure staging absent.
state_predicates_exact.STAGED_FAILURE_SELECTED_SPENT: P1 proves exactly complete FAILURE staging and success staging absent or only the authorized incomplete nonauthoritative partial tree.
state_predicates_exact.TERMINAL_RENAME_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_SPENT: Selected P2 rename/flush/validation call entered but required terminal postconditions are not all proven.
state_predicates_exact.TERMINAL_RENAMED_ATTESTATION_ABSENT_SPEN: P3 proves selected staging absent, terminal destination present with exact identity/membership/hashes, and publication attestation absent.
state_predicates_exact.PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_PRESENT_PENDING_: P4 no-replace rename reports success and exact final publication presence/identity is proven externally; P5 remains pending.
state_predicates_exact.PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_EXPLICIT_FAILURE: P4_PUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6 proves one permitted explicit no-mutation relation, final publication absent, authorization spent and no retry.
state_predicates_exact.PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_RENAME_OUTCOME_U: P4_PUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6 records one of the four uncertain/mutating/no-return/interrupted outcomes and at least one required exact postcondition is unproven.
state_predicates_exact.COMMITTED_SUCCESS_DURABLE_PENDING_AUDIT: A valid CREATE_NEW P5_VALIDATION_RECEIPT_V6 is closed and exact-open verified for SUCCESS; downstream independent result audit remains required.
state_predicates_exact.COMMITTED_FAILURE_DURABLE: A valid CREATE_NEW P5_VALIDATION_RECEIPT_V6 is closed and exact-open verified for FAILURE; invocation remains permanently nonauthoritative.
state_predicates_exact.ILLEGAL_SPLIT_STATE: Observed tuple is outside every legal checkpoint partition or has simultaneous/contradictory roots; conservatively spent and incident-contained.
state_predicates_exact.INCIDENT_REQUIRED_SPENT: First failed checkpoint has one exact nonnull preauthorized trigger not assigned a more specific uncertainty state; authorization spent and incident closeout required.
state_predicates_exact.INCIDENT_CLOSED_REJECTED: Required incident bundle is independently exact-open validated; invocation remains permanently rejected and confers no authority.

process_and_checkpoint_model.state_map_rule: The state_predicates_exact keys and order byte-equal state_keys_in_exact_order. Each reachable observation tuple satisfies exactly one predicate. Missing evidence can select only an uncertainty, incident or illegal state, never a success or unspent state.
process_and_checkpoint_model.P4_P5_noncycle_rule: PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_V6 is finalized only after P3 and carries a prior checkpoint ledger whose last_completed_checkpoint_or_none is P3 and first_failed_checkpoint_or_null is null. It asserts neither P4 nor P5 completion. Exact final publication presence and identity establish P4 success externally. Root then performs P5 against the immutable publication attestation. P5 success is recorded in a separate CREATE_NEW P5_VALIDATION_RECEIPT_V6; P5 failure is recorded only in INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V6 with last_completed P4 and first_failed P5. No P5 artifact validates its own bytes.

flush_plan_model.path_resolution_rule: Within a transaction authorization, resolve each path_key to tx:<transaction_id>:<path_key>. plan_index is the displayed zero-based index. same_path_occurrence is one-based among preceding and current rows with the same resolved path ID. No other path or order is permitted.
flush_plan_model.selection_rule: SUCCESS selects SUCCESS. FAILURE with worker state NEVER_CREATED/NOT_REQUIRED and Root proof commit_staging absent plus quarantine absent selects FAILURE_NO_QUARANTINE. FAILURE with worker state INCOMPLETE_PARTIAL_PRESENT_PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE/PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE and Root proof of unchanged successful quarantine rename selects FAILURE_WITH_QUARANTINE. No other selection is legal.
flush_plan_model.execution_rule: A publication attestation contains every plan row once with HANDLE_OBSERVED and SUCCESS_DURABLE in exact order. An incident contains either an exact empty NOT_ENTERED execution, a contiguous prefix ending at the first non-success observation, or a complete successful plan when the later rename, proof, P4 or P5 step fails. After the first non-success observation no later plan row is attempted or recorded.
flush_plan_model.handle_rule: Every attempted row uses CreateFileW desired_access_hex 0x40000000, share_mode_hex 0x00000007, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT plus FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS only for directories, then exactly FlushFileBuffers and CloseHandle. WriteFile, metadata mutation, rename, delete, truncate, append, mapping and every nonlisted operation are prohibited. Separate read/attribute handles prove identical pre/post PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 values.
flush_plan_model.quarantine_join_rule: For FAILURE_WITH_QUARANTINE, FAILURE_PREPUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6.transaction_parent_post_quarantine_flush_observation_or_null is byte-equal to execution observation plan_index 0 and transaction_parent_post_quarantine_flush_state_or_null is derived SUCCESS_DURABLE. For the other two plans both fields are null. No scalar may be asserted without its unique joined observation.

stage_a_directory_intent_rebinding.snapshot_materialization_rule: ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_FREEZE_V6 stores four complete DIRECTORY_CREATION_INTENT_V4 objects in this order. Each output object's non-snapshot/non-hash fields byte-equal its static_field_templates_in_creation_order row and occur at the exact DIRECTORY_CREATION_INTENT_V4 ordinals. For bootstrap_root_dir, immediate_parent_pre_authority_snapshot is PRESENT DIRECTORY, no-reparse and same-volume for static:campaign_governance_dir. For each child, immediate_parent_pre_authority_snapshot is ABSENT DIRECTORY at freeze time because bootstrap_root_dir is an exact earlier same-role intended parent; immediate pre-call authority later joins that earlier valid creator record as required by the inherited schema without adding a field. Every target pre-authority snapshot is ABSENT DIRECTORY. Snapshot observation fields follow PATH_SNAPSHOT_V4 exactly; intent_payload_sha256 covers every preceding DIRECTORY_CREATION_INTENT_V4 field. No template-only key is serialized.
stage_a_directory_intent_rebinding.global_partition_rule: The four rebound paths occupy their unchanged four positions in the exact 8-path FAIL_STATIC_AUDIT_THEN_ROOT_GOVERNANCE class. The other 33 intent targets and their order, parents, writers, gate semantics and classes remain byte-semantically unchanged. Total remains 37 unique intents partitioned 8/29/0.

governance_header_and_control_model.historical_fail_rule: static:v5_audit is bound inside static:v6 with verdict FAIL_BLOCKING as the finite repair origin. It is not treated as PASS. static:v4, static:v4_audit, static:v5 and static:v5_audit remain authoring provenance and are not future-stage PASS controls. The first seven mandatory values are the exact previously passing bootstrap controls; the impossible V4/V5 prestage tail is replaced by the four V6 controls.
governance_header_and_control_model.operational_role_rule: Before any Stage-A or later read, write, metadata query, membership query, process start, rename or result judgment, each of the eighteen operational roles exact-opens and hashes all eleven mandatory controls. Its effective read_path_ids and typed access attestation contain the exact ordered union of its inherited reads and these eleven values with stable first occurrence. Missing or differently hashed control means no authority.
governance_header_and_control_model.rewrite_rule: The twenty rows are the complete equality-joined replacement of exact_inherited_extracts.governance_header_owner_fields after mapping each replaced V4/V5 owner key to its V6 key. Each named field descriptor is exactly type OBJECT, ref GOVERNANCE_HEADER_V6, nullable false. No effective schema retains a GOVERNANCE_HEADER_V4 reference.
governance_header_and_control_model.binding_chain: static:v6_audit binds exact static:v6 and all four source bindings. static:v6_activation binds exact PASS static:v6_audit and its auditor identity. static:v6_role_assignment_freeze binds exact static:v6, historical static:v5/static:v5_audit, PASS static:v6_audit, activation, auditor/Root identities, the 18 assignments, 153 pairs, 18 auditor-role comparisons and four Stage-A intents. Every subsequent GOVERNANCE_HEADER_V6 directly binds only static:v6, PASS static:v6_audit, static:v6_activation and static:v6_role_assignment_freeze; the seven earlier bootstrap controls are separately mandatory exact reads and are never represented as new PASS claims.

access_attestation_reference_closure.rule: The effective registry restores ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V4 at its exact static:v4 schema value and does not rewrite these eight retained fields. V4_AUDIT_RECEIPT_V4 is historical and is never re-instantiated. Every future instance of the other seven schemas includes all eleven mandatory controls in its inherited read_path_ids with stable-first-occurrence union. ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V6 is used by V6 publication, incident, authorization, P5 and new governance records. Every one of the eight old refs and every new ref resolves once in the effective registry.

canonical_edge_key.constraint: canonical JSON SHA-256 of the preceding eight fields

DELEGATION_CHAIN_V6.conditional_rule: node_count equals nodes length; node_index values are 0 through node_count-1; edge_count equals node_count-1 and edges length; each edge k joins node k to node k+1 by byte-equality of actor and principal fields; leaf_actor_id equals the final node actor; canonical_chain_sha256 covers every preceding field.

proof_sha256.constraint: canonical SHA-256 of all preceding fields

DELEGATION_DISJOINTNESS_PROOF_V6.conditional_rule: Each shared array is the exact raw-UTF-8-sorted intersection extracted from the two equality-joined DELEGATION_CHAIN_V6 objects; no caller-supplied omission is permitted.

identity_tuple_sha256.constraint: canonical SHA-256 of every preceding field

IDENTITY_TUPLE_V6.conditional_rule: actor_id, session_id, process_principal_id, public_attestation_id and implementation_provenance_id byte-equal the leaf delegation node values.

IDENTITY_DIMENSION_COMPARISON_V6.conditional_rule: Rows occur exactly at indices 0 through 5 in identity dimension order. Index 3 requires the nonnull proof joined to both tuples; every other index requires null.

ROLE_CONFLICT_JOIN_ROW_V6.conditional_rule: 0<=left_role_index<right_role_index<18; pair_index follows the frozen formula; IDs and tuples byte-equal the joined assignments; the proof byte-equals dimension row 3 proof.

AUDITOR_ROLE_COMPARISON_V6.conditional_rule: The row joins the bound V6 audit tuple and assignment at role_index; ID, tuple, dimensions and proof are byte-equal to those sources.

CHECKPOINT_LEDGER_V6.conditional_rule: first_failed_checkpoint_or_null, joined_failure_adjacency_row_or_null, raw_failure_observation_or_null and normalized_failure_outcome_or_null are either all null or all nonnull. When nonnull, raw checkpoint_id byte-equals first_failed_checkpoint, raw normalized_outcome byte-equals normalized_failure_outcome, and branch/last/first byte-equal the joined adjacency row. A nonnull first failure requires the exact preauthorized trigger except the sole C2 EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION row with unchanged READY proof, null trigger and UNSPENT_READY_PROVEN_UNCHANGED. Every other failure, uncertainty, process-start incident, P4/P5 failure and illegal tuple is SPENT_CLAIMED_OR_UNCERTAIN. A null first failure requires null adjacency/raw/normalized/trigger, joins one successful-prefix row and is spent after claim. BEFORE_C5 requires a first failure in C1-C4 or no entry beyond C4 and null process object. A first failure at C5 requires C5_OR_LATER_AUTHORITATIVE and one nonnull process object: NOT_STARTED_PROVEN, UNKNOWN_CONSERVATIVELY_SPENT, or STARTED_PROVEN only with RETURNED_TRUE_THEN_CONTROLLER_INTERRUPTED. Any ledger whose last completed checkpoint is C5 or later requires STARTED_PROVEN with RETURNED_TRUE and exact process/handle proof. No second process object exists and later_checkpoint_entered_boolean is always false after first failure.

FLUSH_PLAN_ENTRY_V6.conditional_rule: All fields except resolved_path_id byte-equal the selected flush_plan_model row; resolved_path_id is the exact transaction token substitution.

plan_sha256.constraint: canonical SHA-256 of all preceding fields

FLUSH_PLAN_V6.conditional_rule: entries and count equal the selected exact plan after transaction substitution.

FLUSH_HANDLE_OBSERVATION_V6.conditional_rule: Plan identity, index, path, occurrence and kind byte-equal the joined FLUSH_PLAN_ENTRY_V6. File flags are exactly [FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT]; directory flags add FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS second. SUCCESS_DURABLE requires HANDLE_OBSERVED, operations exactly [FlushFileBuffers,CloseHandle], returns true/true and identical snapshots. EXPLICIT_FAILURE is either EXPLICIT_OPEN_FAILURE_NO_HANDLE with empty operations and null returns, or HANDLE_OBSERVED with operations [FlushFileBuffers,CloseHandle], flush return false, close return true and identical snapshots. DURABILITY_UNCERTAIN covers open-call no-return, a HANDLE_OBSERVED contiguous operation prefix with null/no-return, any failed CloseHandle, conflicting return, missing postcondition or unequal snapshot. No operation may occur after the first unobserved/no-return operation.

FLUSH_PLAN_EXECUTION_V6.conditional_rule: NOT_ENTERED has zero observations/count, null indices and false. FIRST_FAILURE_PREFIX has observations exactly plan[0..k], k is first_non_success_index, observation k is non-success, all prior are SUCCESS_DURABLE, attempted_count=k+1, next_unattempted=k+1 unless k is final, and false. COMPLETE_SUCCESS contains every plan row with SUCCESS_DURABLE, attempted_count equals plan count, null indices and true.

read_path_ids.order: exact effective role/phase row with stable-first-occurrence mandatory-control union

metadata_path_ids.order: effective registered-path metadata expansion in raw path-ID order

runtime_dependency_path_snapshots.constraint: exact selected role-profile entries; empty iff runtime manifest binding null

membership_observations.constraint: one per actually listed registered membership path and none otherwise

directory_creation_records_in_creation_o.constraint: exact successful directory creates by this role in this governed phase

flush_path_ids.constraint: V6 FLUSH_PLAN_EXECUTION_V6 is the sole Root postworker flush scope/evidence; no legacy access-attestation flush scope

flush_observations.constraint: V6 FLUSH_PLAN_EXECUTION_V6 is the sole flush evidence

ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V6.conditional_rule: This is an exact semantic superset of the V5-effective ACCESS_ATTESTATION_V5: every V4 runtime dependency, membership, load, rename, delete, process-start and explicit denial field remains. All arrays byte-equal the effective role/phase allowlist. The eleven controls appear in mandatory_control_reads and read_path_ids. GENERIC_WRITE flush capability appears only in FLUSH_PLAN_EXECUTION_V6 and never write_path_ids. No inferred ancestor, sibling or transitive path authority exists.

ROOT_ACTIVATION_V6.conditional_rule: Auditor tuple byte-equals V6_AUDIT_RECEIPT_V6. All six comparisons and the disjointness proof join the exact auditor and Root tuples. Root writes CREATE_NEW only after V6 PASS.

ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_FREEZE_V6.conditional_rule: The four intent objects instantiate the exact Stage-A templates and snapshot rule. The 18 assignments, 153 pairs and 18 auditor comparisons satisfy role_identity_and_delegation_model exactly. Auditor and Root tuples byte-equal their upstream records.

failure_receipt_binding_or_null.constraint: SUCCESS null; FAILURE exact tx:<transaction_id>:failed_failure after terminal directory publication

failure_receipt_pre_rename_snapshot_or_n.constraint: SUCCESS null; FAILURE PRESENT FILE tx:<transaction_id>:failed_staging_failure immediately before terminal rename

failure_receipt_post_rename_snapshot_or_.constraint: SUCCESS null; FAILURE PRESENT FILE tx:<transaction_id>:failed_failure immediately after terminal rename and parent flush

FAILURE_PREPUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6.conditional_rule: SUCCESS requires null failure binding/pre/post snapshots, both NOT_APPLICABLE_SUCCESS worker states, NOT_APPLICABLE_SUCCESS root disposition and all quarantine rename/snapshot/flush fields null. Every FAILURE requires final binding at failed_failure, pre snapshot at failed_staging_failure, post snapshot at failed_failure, both PRESENT FILE/no-reparse/hardlink-one on the same volume with byte-equal bytes/SHA/file-ID, and final binding equal to the post snapshot. NEVER_CREATED requires NOT_REQUIRED, NONE_REQUIRED_FAILURE and every quarantine field null. INCOMPLETE_PARTIAL_PRESENT_PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE requires PENDING_ROOT_QUARANTINE, QUARANTINED_UNCHANGED_FAILURE, the exact commit_staging_dir-to-quarantine_dir rename pair, PRESENT source-before, ABSENT destination-before, ABSENT source-after, PRESENT destination-after with identical directory file-ID and volume to source-before, and a nonnull flush observation byte-equal to selected FAILURE_WITH_QUARANTINE execution row 0. Its scalar is derived SUCCESS_DURABLE. No other combination exists.

worker_access_contract.constraint: exact inherited worker allowlist plus eleven mandatory control reads; delete remains empty

TRANSACTION_AUTHORIZATION_V6.conditional_rule: All three plans share transaction_id and exactly instantiate flush_plan_model. The incident binding freezes all fourteen triggers before claim. No plan grants worker flush or Root content mutation.

terminal_bundle_binding.constraint: exact committed or failed bundle manifest after P3

prior_checkpoint_ledger.constraint: last completed P3, first failed null

PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_V6.conditional_rule: The prior ledger has selected branch equal terminal kind, last P3, null failure, authoritative STARTED_PROVEN process object and no P4/P5 claim. Read attestation is exact 4 SUCCESS or 3 FAILURE complete rows. Flush execution is the exact selected plan with every row durable. Failure disposition joins its quarantine row. No staging-self snapshot, final-path observation or P4/P5 completion claim occurs in these bytes; P4 path observations occur only after bytes are finalized and are carried by the later P5 receipt or P4 incident disposition.
PUBLICATION_ATTESTATION_V6.hash_domain: All fields except attestation_payload_hash_envelope; the artifact bytes are finalized after P3 and before P4 rename. No field asserts P4 or P5 completion.

P4_PUBLICATION_DISPOSITION_V6.conditional_rule: A snapshot field is nonnull exactly when its role token occurs in observed_snapshot_roles_in_exact_order. EXPLICIT_FAILURE_PROVEN_NO_MUTATION requires all four role tokens and nonnull snapshots; it is legal only for CREATE_STAGING with both staging snapshots ABSENT and both final snapshots ABSENT, or NO_REPLACE_RENAME with byte/identity-equal PRESENT complete staging snapshots and both final snapshots ABSENT. It selects the matching explicit_failure_relation and explicit-failure state. Every other normalized outcome requires NOT_APPLICABLE_UNCERTAIN and the uncertainty state; any unavailable full snapshot is null and no favorable unchanged relation is inferred. Observations occur after the failure and live only in the later incident hash domain.

publication_attestation_post_open_snapsh.constraint: PRESENT FILE, exact binding identity/hash, no reparse

P5_VALIDATION_RECEIPT_V6.conditional_rule: The prevalidation ledger has selected branch equal terminal kind, last P4, null failure and authoritative STARTED_PROVEN process object. The seven checks are schema, header bindings, attestation bytes/SHA, attestation path identity, terminal bundle identity/membership/hashes, complete selected flush plan, and selected-branch read proof in that order. This receipt records the completed validation observation of prior immutable objects, never its own finalization. P5 becomes externally complete only after this CREATE_NEW receipt is closed and exact-open verified. Validation failure or any receipt create/close/exact-open failure selects the P5 trigger with last_completed P4 and first_failed P5.

INCIDENT_RECEIPT_V6.conditional_rule: trigger_id byte-equals checkpoint_ledger incident trigger and the bound authorization contains it. There is no standalone process outcome field. Before P1 all optional evidence fields are null. P1/P2 read failure carries the truthful selected read prefix. A flush-plan failure carries the exact first-failure prefix; a later failure after full flush carries COMPLETE_SUCCESS. Exactly a P4-triggered incident requires nonnull p4_publication_disposition byte-equal to checkpoint outcome/state; every other incident requires it null. operation_language.REPLACE_FIELD_CONST: Require the named field and its exact source descriptor, then replace only const and any displayed constraint.
operation_language.REPLACE_FIELD_DESCRIPTOR: Require byte-equality to the source descriptor at the named field, then replace it with the displayed complete descriptor at the same field position.
operation_language.RENAME_AND_REPLACE_FIELD: Require the old field/descriptor, replace the field name and descriptor at the identical ordinal position, and reject either name elsewhere.
operation_language.ADD_FIELD_AFTER: Require the anchor once and insert the displayed complete field immediately after it.
operation_language.ADD_FIELD_BEFORE: Require the anchor once and insert the displayed complete field immediately before it.
operation_language.REMOVE_FIELD: Require the exact old field/descriptor and remove it once.
operation_language.REPLACE_SCHEMA_ID: Require the source schema_id value once and replace it with the displayed globally unique value.
operation_language.CONJOIN_CONDITIONAL_RULE: Preserve every source conditional and append the displayed conjunct; it cannot weaken, delete or reinterpret a source condition.
